points.text: Limited contribution; implications of the SimPO analysis for algorithm design unclear
No theoretical explanation of why maximum entropy RL fails online
Equivalence non-rigorous: length-normalized temperature prevents log Z cancellation
Online failure shown only on small Pythia models; unclear for 7B+
Only TL;DR summarization task; unclear for more complex alignment tasks
Temperature depends on y via length normalization, which is not analyzed theoretically
Margin hyperparameter gamma not related to maximum entropy RL
Experiments only on small models; need modern base models like Qwen, LLaMA
Novelty weak: reward hacking with entropy known; no insight on handling entropy-reward relation
Experiments only on small models; need more diverse base models
No formal results for the SimPO-MaxEnt connection in main paper; conditions unclear
Derivation cancels log Z only for constant alpha; fails for length-dependent temperature
Margin gamma added by analogy, not derived
Constant-alpha margin-free case is known uniform-reference DPO reading (Liu et al.)
MaxEnt and KL runs use very different learning rates
Entropy coefficient grid too small to match working KL regularization strength
MaxEnt and KL objectives differ in reference term and length scaling simultaneously
Offline/online asymmetry not shown; App. B suggests learning-rate effect; no 2.8B SimPO run
Claim that entropy exacerbates reward hacking rests on correlation
Entropy coefficient-0 run cited but not shown
Single runs, no seeds or variance
Reward model and TL;DR split unspecified
GPT-4o-mini judge not validated; no human check or sample outputs
Overoptimization inferred from win-rate collapse alone; may be output pathology
Minimum Entropy RL, clipping, epsilon experiment and reproduction failure claimed without evidence
Typos and Eq. 17 bracket
Learning rate for 2.8B KL runs inconsistent between text and Fig. 3
Abstract's "consistently overoptimizes" contradicted by 1B low-learning-rate runs
Claim that dataset constraints explain offline success unsupported
Abstract's "consistently exhibits overoptimization" contradicted by results and body text
Conclusion generalizes from two small models and one dataset
Abstract final sentence vague
Dense multi-panel figures hide main evidence; no summary results table
Section 4.2.2 contains no figure
Insight weak for venue: main result "unsurprising", new parts single-run and unexplained
Typos and inconsistent KL-constrained/regularized terminology
Sequence-level entropy assumption unexamined; bonus rewards degenerate outputs; paradox under-explained
Evidence from two small models, one dataset, one judge; claims overgeneralized
No practical guidance for practitioners, e.g., learning-rate window or collapse monitor
Ethics statement generic
SimPO-MaxEnt equivalence invalid under length-normalized alpha; appendix concedes missing normalization and margin
Learning rate, coefficient scale and reference term differ between MaxEnt and KL runs
Offline/online asymmetry contradicted by App. B; no 2.8B SimPO run
Causal entropy claim read from correlated curves
Coefficient-0 run not shown
"Consistently exhibits overoptimization" contradicted by 1B results
Minimum Entropy and clipping results described without data
No seeds or variance; small differences interpreted
Text and Fig. 3 legend disagree on learning rate
Contextual-bandit view cited to an exploration-in-bandits paper
"Fully reproducible" claimed while reward model, split, seeds, code absent
Typos
Length normalization breaks log Z cancellation; equivalence statement unsupported
Margin gamma added following psiPO, not derived
Derived constant-alpha result is known DPO uniform-reference reading; novelty incremental
Online length-weighted entropy objective does not correspond to SimPO's closed form
Contextual bandit view cited to non-RLHF source
Relevant prior work on maximum entropy failure and overoptimization not engaged; missing references
Dataset constraints claim asserted, not tested
